chunks: And with this chain of transmission, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from a number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿUthmān ibn ʿĪsā, from Samāʿah, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
When you shroud the deceased, then sprinkle upon each cloth a little of scented powder and camphor.

key_terms.ثَوْبٍ: a cloth; here, one piece of the burial shroud
key_terms.ذَرِيرَةٍ: a scented powder or perfume used in funerary preparation
key_terms.كَافُورٍ: camphor, used in preparing the deceased
key_terms.كَفَّنْتَ: you shrouded; wrapped the deceased in burial cloths

ai.seo_question: What should be placed on the shroud when preparing a deceased person for burial?
ai.summary: This hadith gives an instruction regarding preparing the deceased for burial. It states that when the deceased is shrouded, a small amount of dharīrah and camphor should be sprinkled on each piece of the shroud, indicating part of the funerary rites in Islamic jurisprudence.
